title: Shipping rules
hints: Write `freeShipping` first as one boolean expression; no `if` needed. Then `shippingCost` can start with `if (freeShipping(…)) return 0;`.

In `freeShipping`, combine "member or big order" with `||`, put it in parentheses, and `&&` it with the weight limit. In `shippingCost`, check the weight bands from the top: freight (over 20) first, then up to 1, then up to 5, then everything else.

freeShipping: `return (isMember || subtotal >= 50) && weightKg <= 20;`  ·  shippingCost: `if (freeShipping(subtotal, weightKg, isMember)) return 0; if (weightKg > 20) return 25; if (weightKg <= 1) return 4; if (weightKg <= 5) return 8; return 12;`
